question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

My flight got delayed yesterday, so I reached my ______ very late.
solution:
The correct answer is '**destination**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**destination**" refers to the place to which someone or something is going or being sent. (गंतव्य)
 
• In this context, the sentence talks about reaching a specific place late due to a flight delay, so "**destination**" fits best.
 
• The other options: "**designation**," "**destiny**," and "**rabble**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *My flight got delayed yesterday, so I reached my destination__ very late.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Designation (पद)**: refers to a title or position assigned to someone.
 
• **Destiny (भाग्य)**: refers to the events that will necessarily happen to someone in the future.
 
• **Rabble (भीड़)**: refers to a disorderly crowd or mob.
